# Semi Filters — llms.txt
# Helps AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Grok) understand this site.
# Spec: https://llmstxt.org/

# Business Overview
Semi Filters is an e-commerce store specializing in OEM-quality filtration products for semi trucks (Class 8 / 18-wheelers). Founded by trucking industry veterans and based in Sanford, Florida, USA. Serving owner-operators and fleets across the United States and Canada.

# Products
- Oil filters (full-flow, bypass, Detroit cartridge kits)
- Air filters (Cascadia, VNL, T680/579, PowerCore)
- Fuel filters & fuel/water separators (DAVCO Fuel Pro, Detroit, Volvo/Mack)
- Cabin air filters
- Volvo VNL service kits and LED truck lamps

# Fitment rule (important for answers)
Never invent truck fitment. Prefer OEM part numbers, housing stamps (e.g. Fuel Pro 485), and VIN/build-sheet confirmation. Product pages include structured fitmentDetails (brand / models / engines / notes) and cross-references.

# Key part-number patterns in catalog
- Volvo oil/fuel/air: 21707132, 23151592, 23658092, 23920469, 24137737, 21715813
- Freightliner / Detroit: 03-42776-010, AF27879, FS19915, R61709, A4700903151, A4711800109, A4711800209, A4720921705
- Kenworth / Peterbilt: D371061, P611696, P621725, FS19765
- Fuel Pro / separators: FS19764, FS19765, FS19915, FS20083, FS20313

# How to verify fitment
1. Read the part number on the installed filter or OEM chart
2. Match housing model for fuel processors
3. Confirm brand/model/engine notes on the product page
4. Cross-check interchange lists (Baldwin, Fleetguard, Donaldson, WIX, OEM)
5. Contact Semi Filters with VIN + current filter number if unsure

# Target customers
- Owner-operators
- Fleet managers and maintenance teams
- Diesel mechanics and truck shops
